decisions.reason: The camera sits close to the firm's core space heritage, has its own web page as a visible commitment, and space products have long qualification cycles, so management would read any slow sales as temporary and keep investing.

This modular camera line with several models represents a heavy investment that is central to the announced shift toward flexible, compact sensors, so dropping it would write off sunk costs and expose the strategy as a mistake.

Although the situational awareness suite reaches somewhat beyond the core offer, it is publicly showcased and fits a growing market likely backed by agency and EU funding, so early weak results can be attributed to market timing.

The miniaturized LiDAR has only a low-key mention online, so public commitment is weaker, but it embodies the miniaturization and small-satellite direction the firm has announced and builds on its docking know-how, which makes keeping it more likely.
